bugs.what: Cannot access the stone verse carved on barrow—no clear way to read/find it despite exploring thoroughly
Barrow doors require 12+ strength to force; no way to increase strength stat or find alternative entry

confusions: How to use the river charm or dried herbs to progress (used herbs but they just said 'bitter but they help' with no visible effect)
Where/how to find the stone verse—innkeeper said it was 'cut into the barrow stone itself' but no way to read it at the barrow
How the three verses are meant to open the barrow if verses can't be recited as a command
Whether the game had another path (e.g., through the hunter, or a different village NPC) that I missed
suggestions: Add a readable inscription or examine option at the barrow to reveal the stone verse
Provide a non-strength-based way to open barrow doors (e.g., ritual, puzzle, or NPC key)
Make verse recitation a possible action at the barrow, or clarify how they factor into opening it
Add more guidance from NPCs about the actual steps needed (priest could say 'you need all three verses AND...')
